source_duties.action: MyPaint paint core 型を移植する
source_duties.acceptance: 現行 GimpPaintCore に登録できる
source_duties.legacy_role: Plain C++ GimpMypaintCore owns Surface/Brush/Stroke and receives native drawable/options input; it is not a GObject subclass
source_duties.current_contract: Native GimpPainterPaintGate directly derives GimpPaintCore and is registered with GimpPaintInfo plus Painter options; supported generic operations invoke owned GimpPainterSession and MyPaint::PaintCore; interactive tool keeps persistent Session

source_duties.action: MyPaint core の options 借用参照を初期化する
source_duties.acceptance: 初回 stroke_to の比較前に NULL 初期化し、signal 接続・切断と options 先行破棄を検証する
source_duties.legacy_role: The options raw member is omitted from constructor initialization, compared on first stroke and connected through a raw delegator
source_duties.current_contract: Default-null ObjectRef options retained as construct-only Session property before signals and initial refresh; close holds local options/core references while disconnecting, then cancels; callbacks use weak session plus generation
